name: Training & Workshops
description: Designing practical learning experiences that help members move from concepts to confident, hands-on application through workshops, sessions, and skill-building initiatives.

name: Web Development
description: Building modern, responsive, and purposeful web experiences while developing strong foundations in frontend, backend, interfaces, and real-world product development.

name: XR Development
description: Exploring extended reality through AR, VR, and immersive experiences that blend technology, interaction, storytelling, and experimentation.

name: Publicity & Outreach
description: Connecting the club with students, communities, and collaborators through strategic promotion, outreach initiatives, partnerships, and audience engagement.

name: Content & Social Media
description: Shaping the club's voice across digital platforms through thoughtful storytelling, campaigns, copy, and social content that informs, engages, and builds community.

name: Multimedia Management
description: Planning and producing visual media — including photography, video, editing, and event coverage — to document the club and communicate its work with impact.

name: Finance
description: Supporting sustainable execution through budgeting, expense planning, financial records, resource allocation, and responsible management of the club's operational needs.

name: Management
description: Coordinating people, timelines, responsibilities, and execution so that ideas move smoothly from planning to completion with accountability and clarity.

name: PR & Sponsorship
description: Building professional relationships with external organisations, partners, speakers, and sponsors while creating mutually valuable opportunities for collaboration.

name: Aesthetics
description: Crafting the club's visual identity across branding, design, event presentation, interfaces, and creative direction so every touchpoint feels coherent and memorable.
